sections.title: Overview
sections.body:
When the Italian civil war breaks out, the Republic splits into **six factions**: the government in Rome (ITA), the revolutionary left (INT), the Stalinist front (SRI), the fascists (RSI) and two separatist movements, Padania (LOM) and South Tyrol (TYR). The 35 Italian states are divided between them at once, each faction receives its own army, and the wars are declared.

- Italy leaves its military alliance, loses 30% stability and gains 10% war support.
- Two days later the Armed Forces Joint Command (F.F.A.A.) takes power in Rome and turns the government into a military dictatorship.
- A player who is Italy chooses which faction to play.
- The Internationale has cores on all of Italy and founds the international organisation "The International".

> **Development status:** in the current version of the mod the civil war can only be started from the debug decision `DVE_debug_italy_civil_war` and is not yet wired to a focus. The partition and the armies below are the ones the script applies.

sections.title: Events
sections.body:
**Before the war** (news events sent to every country, while Italy is not yet in its civil war)

**March Against All Wars**
> Genoa. On a mild, sunny Saturday, Via San Lorenzo and the entire city center, teeming with the red flags of 'Lotta Comunista', were once again on strike. Thousands and thousands of people marched in an orderly fashion along the route, from Piazza Caricamento and Piazza De Ferrari, through Piazza Dante and Via XX Settembre, accompanied by car sound systems broadcasting the strains of 'The Internationale' and 'Bandiera Rossa'. This was not May Day, the date traditionally dedicated by workers' groups to city marches, but a demonstration planned weeks in advance to say 'NO TO ALL WARS'. The fragile truce in Gaza changes little. Gaza is not the only ongoing conflict in the world, and that 'fragile truce' neither erases the massacre of the civilian population nor allows for a hopeful outlook on the future. Then there are the wars in Ukraine and Sudan, as well as many other forgotten conflicts.

**The Strike for Ilva**
> The strikes at the former Ilva plant in Genoa represent a united response from workers and unions against the threat of a gradual, silent dismantling of the industrial complex. The protest erupted when the government unveiled a plan entailing substantial production cuts. For the workers in Genoa, this would mean a sharp rise in the number of employees relying on the wage guarantee fund - affecting nearly a thousand staff members. Asserting their right to work and produce steel, the workers responded with full-scale mobilization: they established a permanent picket line outside the factories - braving cold nights outdoors to guard the gates - and took to the streets with general strikes, massive marches, and road blockades that paralyzed key points across the city. This tenacious resistance is also backed by workers from other industrial sites, the party 'Lotta Comunista', and the people of Genoa.

**When the war breaks out**

**The Guns Fall Silent, the Generals Speak**
> Two days into the collapse, whatever remains of the government in Rome finds that the only institution still intact enough to give orders is the Armed Forces Joint Command. It does not ask for the office. It simply takes it.

**Italy Tears Itself Apart**
> The Republic has broken into pieces. The Internationale holds the industrial north, the Stalinists rule from Naples, the Black Barons have taken Rome, and Padania and South Tyrol want nothing more to do with any of them. Every Italian has to choose a side. So do you.

`INT_cw_revolutionary_fervor` | 6 | Requires: Rehabilitating Factories for the Revolution + Every Weapon Must Be Used | Every civil war has a moment when fear turns into momentum, and the side that reaches it first usually wins. In the north, that moment has come. | | **A Revolutionary Vanguard Army**
`INT_cw_revolutionary_vanguard_army` | 6 | Requires: Rehabilitating Factories for the Revolution + Call to Arms for the Proletariat | The best of the militias are pulled out of the line, re-equipped and drilled into a strike force. They will be first through every breach, and they know it. | | **If Lenin Could See Us...**
`INT_cw_if_lenin_could_see_us` | 7 | Requires: Revolutionary Fervor + A Revolutionary Vanguard Army | The last resistance in Rome has laid down its arms and the red flag flies over the Quirinale. Someone in the crowd wonders aloud what the old man would have made of it. Nobody answers. There is a country to build. |

sections.title: Post-war focus tree — Economy (43 focuses)
sections.body:
| Focus | Tier | Requirements | Description | |---|---|---|---| | **The Question of the Socialist Economy**
`INT_eco_socialist_economy_question` | 1 | — | The war is won, the factories are ours and nobody agrees on what to do with them. The congress will have to decide what kind of economy the revolution is going to build. | | **Socialization of the Means of Production**
`INT_eco_socialization_means` | 2 | Requires: The Question of the Socialist Economy
Excludes: Collectivization of the Means of Production | Not the state but the workers themselves: every plant is handed to the council that runs it, and the councils answer to each other rather than to a ministry in Rome. | | **Collectivization of the Means of Production**
`INT_eco_collectivization_means` | 2 | Requires: The Question of the Socialist Economy
Excludes: Socialization of the Means of Production | The revolution cannot afford a thousand factories pulling in a thousand directions. Industry passes into collective ownership under a single plan, and the plan answers to the revolution. | | **From Each According to his Abilities**
`INT_eco_from_each_abilities` | 3 | Requires: Socialization of the Means of Production | Work is reorganized around what people can actually do, not around what a contract says. Engineers go back to the drawing board, and the drawing board goes back to the shop floor. | | **Workspace Democracy**
`INT_eco_workspace_democracy` | 3 | Requires: Socialization of the Means of Production | Shifts, targets and foremen are now voted on at the factory assembly. The meetings are long, but the absenteeism figures have never been lower. | | **Socialization of Factories**
`INT_eco_socialization_factories` | 3 | Requires: Socialization of the Means of Production | From Mirafiori to the steelworks of Terni, every plant that closed under the old owners reopens under its workers. | | **Nationalize Private Enterprises**
`INT_eco_nationalize_private` | 3 | Requires: Collectivization of the Means of Production | Banks, utilities and the big industrial groups pass into collective hands by decree. The old boards of directors are invited to explain themselves. | | **State's Unions Based Economy**
`INT_eco_state_unions_economy` | 3 | Requires: Collectivization of the Means of Production | The unions stop negotiating with the state and become the state's economic arm, from the ministry down to the shop steward. | | **Work Coercion**
`INT_eco_work_coercion` | 3 | Requires: Collectivization of the Means of Production | Rebuilding after a civil war is not a matter of choice. Labour is assigned, and refusing the assignment is sabotage. | | **To Each According to his Needs**
`INT_eco_to_each_needs` | 4 | Requires: From Each According to his Abilities or Workspace Democracy | Housing, food and healthcare are distributed by need rather than by income. The queues are shorter than anyone expected. | | **Peer-to-Peer Economy**
`INT_eco_peer_to_peer_economy` | 4 | Requires: Workspace Democracy | Councils trade parts, designs and spare capacity directly with each other over an open network, without a middleman taking a cut. | | **Agricultural Communes**
`INT_eco_agricultural_communes` | 4 | Requires: Socialization of Factories + Workspace Democracy | The estates of the Po valley are split into communes run by the people who work them. The cities will not go hungry. | | **Seize the Wealth**
`INT_eco_seize_the_wealth` | 4 | Requires: Nationalize Private Enterprises + State's Unions Based Economy | Villas on Lake Como, yachts in Portofino, accounts in Lugano. What can be reached is taken; what cannot is put on a list for later. | | **Militarization of the Economy**
`INT_eco_militarization_economy` | 4 | Requires: State's Unions Based Economy | The revolution has enemies on every border. Production is organized like an army, because it may soon have to supply one. | | **Labor Mobilization**
`INT_eco_labor_mobilization` | 4 | Requires: Work Coercion + State's Unions Based Economy | Labour brigades are formed in every province and sent wherever the plan needs hands. | | **Five-Year Plans**
`INT_eco_five_year_plans` | 5 | Requires: To Each According to his Needs + Peer-to-Peer Economy + Agricultural Communes | The councils have their own targets; now they need a common horizon. The first plan is drafted from the bottom up, factory by factory. | | **Collective Economic Outlook**
`INT_eco_collective_economic_outlook` | 5 | Requires: Seize the Wealth + Militarization of the Economy + Labor Mobilization | The transition is over. What was expropriated is now organized, and what was organized now produces. | | **Investments in Artificial Intelligence**
`INT_eco_investments_ai` | 6 | Requires: Five-Year Plans | The models that once optimized advertising and share prices can just as easily optimize a production schedule. | | **Unified State Network of Computer Centers**
`INT_eco_unified_computer_network` | 6 | Requires: Five-Year Plans | The Soviets dreamed of it in the sixties and never built it. Every council, depot and plant is wired into one planning network. | | **Green Quotas**
`INT_eco_green_quotas` | 6 | Requires: Five-Year Plans | Emissions become a target like any other, counted and planned alongside steel and grain. | | **Recreate the Sovkhozes**
`INT_eco_recreate_sovkhozes` | 6 | Requires: Collective Economic Outlook | State farms, run by agronomists and farmed by salaried workers. Not romantic, but the harvest is predictable. | | **Restart the Five-Year Plans**
`INT_eco_restart_five_year_plans` | 6 | Requires: Collective Economic Outlook | Gosplan had its faults, but it built an industrial power out of a peasant country in twenty years. | | **Meritocratic Socialism**
`INT_eco_meritocratic_socialism` | 6 | Requires: Collective Economic Outlook | Posts in the planning apparatus go to whoever passes the exam, not to whoever has the right party card. | | **Smart Production Chains**
`INT_eco_smart_production_chains` | 7 | Requires: Investments in Artificial Intelligence + Unified State Network of Computer Centers | Supply chains that reroute themselves around a broken machine or a missing shipment before anyone has to pick up a phone. | | **AI Reviewed Economic Planning**
`INT_eco_ai_economic_planning` | 7 | Requires: Unified State Network of Computer Centers | The councils still write the plan. The machines only check it, and they are very good at finding the mistakes. | | **Eco-Data Monitoring Network**
`INT_eco_ecodata_monitoring` | 7 | Requires: Green Quotas or Unified State Network of Computer Centers | Sensors along every river and chimney feed the planning network in real time. | | **Socialist Modernization**
`INT_eco_socialist_modernization` | 7 | Requires: Recreate the Sovkhozes + Restart the Five-Year Plans | Roads, railways and power lines reach the valleys and villages the old governments forgot. | | **Centralize Economic Planning**
`INT_eco_centralize_economic_planning` | 7 | Requires: Restart the Five-Year Plans | One plan, one planning office, one set of figures. Regional committees keep their say, but no longer their veto. | | **Network of Computer Servers**
`INT_eco_network_computer_servers` | 7 | Requires: Meritocratic Socialism + Restart the Five-Year Plans | The plan outgrows paper. A national server network keeps every figure current and every ministry honest. | | **Decentralize the System**
`INT_eco_decentralize_system` | 8 | Requires: Smart Production Chains + AI Reviewed Economic Planning | With the network in place, decisions can move back down to the councils without losing sight of the whole. | | **Variable Production Quotas**
`INT_eco_variable_production_quotas` | 8 | Requires: AI Reviewed Economic Planning | Quotas that change week by week with demand, instead of a five-year number that is wrong by the second winter. | | **Clean Energy Grid**
`INT_eco_clean_energy_grid` | 8 | Requires: Eco-Data Monitoring Network or AI Reviewed Economic Planning | Alpine hydro, southern solar and a grid that moves power to wherever the plan needs it. | | **Ecological Development**
`INT_eco_ecological_development` | 8 | Requires: Socialist Modernization or Centralize Economic Planning | Growth that does not poison the Po. The plan now counts rivers and air as well as tonnes of steel. | | **Fight Corruption Within the Apparatus**
`INT_eco_fight_corruption_apparatus` | 8 | Requires: Centralize Economic Planning | Every planned economy grows its own parasites. A few public trials remind the apparatus who it works for. | | **Advanced Economic Planning**
`INT_eco_advanced_economic_planning` | 8 | Requires: Network of Computer Servers | Input-output tables that used to take a ministry a year are now recalculated overnight. | | **A Supercomputer for Each Council**
`INT_eco_supercomputer_each_council` | 9 | Requires: Decentralize the System or Variable Production Quotas | Every council gets the computing power that once belonged only to banks and intelligence agencies. | | **Automation of Factories and Agriculture**
`INT_eco_automation_factories` | 9 | Requires: Variable Production Quotas | Under the old owners automation meant layoffs. Under the councils it means a shorter working week. | | **Full Ecological Transition**
`INT_eco_full_ecological_transition` | 9 | Requires: Clean Energy Grid or Variable Production Quotas | The last coal plant closes, and the plan finally balances what the country takes from the land against what it gives back. | | **Reward Heavy Industry**
`INT_eco_rewards_heavy_industry` | 9 | Requires: Ecological Development | Steel, machine tools and chemicals get first call on investment, workers and prestige. | | **Radical Redistribution of Wealth**
`INT_eco_radical_redistribution` | 9 | Requires: Fight Corruption Within the Apparatus | What the old elite accumulated over a century is spread across the whole working population in a single year. | | **Integrated Advanced Search**
`INT_eco_integrated_advanced_search` | 9 | Requires: Advanced Economic Planning | Any engineer in any plant can find any design, part or spare machine in the country in seconds. | | **Full-Blown Digital Marxism**
`INT_eco_digital_marxism` | 10 | Requires: A Supercomputer for Each Council + Automation of Factories and Agriculture + Full Ecological Transition | A planned economy that plans itself, run by the councils and computed by the network. Marx never saw a microchip, but he would have recognized the idea. | | **A True Trotskyist Revolution**
`INT_eco_true_trotskyist_revolution` | 10 | Requires: Reward Heavy Industry + Radical Redistribution of Wealth + Integrated Advanced Search | An economy built not for one country but as the arsenal and granary of a revolution that does not stop at the border. |

sections.title: Post-war focus tree — Politics (41 focuses)
sections.body:
| Focus | Tier | Requirements | Description | |---|---|---|---| | **Unified Congress of Internationalist Communists**
`INT_pol_unified_congress` | 1 | — | Every current that fought the civil war is in the same hall in Milan for the first time since the fighting ended. Only one of them will leave with a majority. | | **Lotta Comunista Majority**
`INT_pol_lotta_comunista_majority` | 2 | Requires: Unified Congress of Internationalist Communists
Excludes: PCR Majority | The Leninists of Lotta Comunista carry the congress. The revolution will be led by a disciplined party of cadres and organized through the workers' councils. | | **PCR Majority**
`INT_pol_pcr_majority` | 2 | Requires: Unified Congress of Internationalist Communists
Excludes: Lotta Comunista Majority | The Revolutionary Communist Party wins the vote. The revolution will not rest in one country: it is permanent or it is nothing. | | **Cheka Model**
`INT_pol_cheka_model` | 3 | Requires: Lotta Comunista Majority | The counter-revolution did not surrender with the army. A commission for the struggle against sabotage is set up, with wide powers and few questions asked. | | **The State of the Councils**
`INT_pol_state_of_councils` | 3 | Requires: Lotta Comunista Majority | Power is organized from the bottom up: factory councils elect city councils, city councils elect the congress. Every delegate can be recalled. | | **Marx, Engels, Cervetto**
`INT_pol_marx_engels_cervetto` | 3 | Requires: Lotta Comunista Majority | Arrigo Cervetto's analysis of imperialism becomes the party's theoretical backbone, next to the classics it was built on. | | **Trotskyism**
`INT_pol_trotskyism` | 3 | Requires: PCR Majority | The party openly claims the legacy of the Fourth International: workers' democracy at home, permanent revolution abroad. | | **New Communism for a New Age**
`INT_pol_new_communism_new_age` | 3 | Requires: PCR Majority | The revolution of the twenty-first century will not be a copy of the one in the twentieth. The party rewrites its program for a world of networks and automation. | | **Stalinism Is a Degeneration of Socialism**
`INT_pol_stalinism_degeneration` | 3 | Requires: PCR Majority | The Revolution Betrayed is required reading for every cadre. The bureaucracy that strangled the Soviet state will not be allowed to grow here. | | **A New Agit-Prop**
`INT_pol_new_agit_prop` | 4 | Requires: Cheka Model | Posters and pamphlets have given way to videos and feeds, but the job is the same: explain the revolution faster than its enemies can slander it. | | **Workers' Clubs**
`INT_pol_workers_clubs` | 4 | Requires: The State of the Councils | The circoli operai that kept the movement alive through the lean decades become the schools of the new state. | | **True Leninism**
`INT_pol_true_leninism` | 4 | Requires: Marx, Engels, Cervetto | Lenin without the embalming: a party of professional revolutionaries, internationalist to the core and suspicious of any state that calls itself socialist. | | **United Front Tactic**
`INT_pol_united_front_tactic` | 4 | Requires: Trotskyism | March separately, strike together. The other currents of the left are brought into the work of government instead of being pushed into opposition. | | **Create the City Soviets**
`INT_pol_city_soviets` | 4 | Requires: New Communism for a New Age | Every city gets its soviet, elected by the workplaces and answerable to the party's revolutionary program. | | **China, a Deviated Socialism**
`INT_pol_china_deviated_socialism` | 4 | Requires: Stalinism Is a Degeneration of Socialism | Billionaires with party cards and workers without unions. Whatever China is building, it is not socialism. | | **Repudiate Stalinism**
`INT_pol_repudiate_stalinism` | 5 | Requires: A New Agit-Prop | The Stalinists in Naples called themselves communists too. The congress states it plainly: what they built was a bureaucracy, not socialism. | | **Factory Councils**
`INT_pol_factory_councils` | 5 | Requires: Workers' Clubs | Gramsci wrote about them in Turin a century ago. Now every plant has one, and it does not ask the owners' permission. | | **Democratic Centralism**
`INT_pol_democratic_centralism` | 5 | Requires: True Leninism | Freedom of discussion, unity of action. The debate can last all night, but in the morning the whole party moves as one. | | **Concessions to the Leninists**
`INT_pol_concessions_leninists` | 5 | Requires: United Front Tactic | Lotta Comunista lost the congress but not its cadres. It gets seats on the committees in exchange for its discipline. | | **Militarized Labour Unions**
`INT_pol_militarized_labour_unions` | 5 | Requires: Create the City Soviets | Trotsky proposed it in 1920 and lost the argument. The unions become production armies, with ranks, discipline and quotas. | | **Contacts with Vietnam**
`INT_pol_contacts_vietnam` | 5 | Requires: China, a Deviated Socialism | Hanoi has its own reasons to distrust Beijing. A delegation is sent to find out how far that distrust goes. | | **China Is Imperialist**
`INT_pol_china_is_imperialist` | 6 | Requires: Repudiate Stalinism | A red flag over Beijing does not change what Beijing does abroad: it exports capital, buys ports and collects debts like any other imperial power. | | **City Councils**
`INT_pol_city_councils` | 6 | Requires: Factory Councils | Prefects and mayors are replaced by councils elected from the neighbourhoods and workplaces of every city. | | **Establish the Councils' Political Commissariats**
`INT_pol_councils_political_commissariats` | 6 | Requires: Democratic Centralism | The councils send their own commissars into the army and the ministries, so that no institution drifts away from the people who elected it. | | **Concessions to the LeftCom**
`INT_pol_concessions_leftcom` | 6 | Requires: Concessions to the Leninists | The left communists never trusted any party, including this one. Guarantees for the councils keep them on side. | | **Militarization of the Policy**
`INT_pol_militarization_of_policy` | 6 | Requires: Militarized Labour Unions | Politics becomes the continuation of war by other means. Every ministry is organized as if the front were one valley away. | | **Contacts with the African Socialists**
`INT_pol_contacts_african_socialists` | 6 | Requires: Contacts with Vietnam | From Asmara to the Sahel, there are movements that remember who supported the anti-colonial wars. The party reopens those channels. | | **The US Is a Decrepit Wreck**
`INT_pol_us_decrepit_wreck` | 7 | Requires: China Is Imperialist | The empire that bankrolled every counter-revolution of the last century can no longer keep its own bridges standing. | | **Economic Planning Based on Councils**
`INT_pol_council_based_planning` | 7 | Requires: City Councils | The plan is assembled from what each council says it needs and can produce, not handed down from above. | | **Flexible Tactics**
`INT_pol_flexible_tactics` | 7 | Requires: Establish the Councils' Political Commissariats | Firm on principles, flexible on everything else. The party learns to retreat when it must and advance when it can. | | **Concessions to the Soc-Dem**
`INT_pol_concessions_socdem` | 7 | Requires: Concessions to the LeftCom | The unions and the old social democrats get a voice on wages and welfare. In return, they stop asking for elections. | | **A Complete Ideological Revolution**
`INT_pol_complete_ideological_revolution` | 7 | Requires: Militarization of the Policy | Schools, newspapers and theatres are turned over to the revolution. A new generation is raised without the old reflexes. | | **Alliance with Cuba**
`INT_pol_alliance_with_cuba` | 7 | Requires: Contacts with the African Socialists | Havana has survived sixty years of embargo on its own. It will not have to survive the next sixty alone. | | **Communism or Barbarism**
`INT_pol_communism_or_barbarism` | 8 | Requires: The US Is a Decrepit Wreck | There is no third way and no return to the old order. Either the working class takes the world, or the world goes back to the barbarism it came from. | | **All Power to the Councils!**
`INT_pol_all_power_to_councils` | 8 | Requires: Economic Planning Based on Councils | The old slogan of 1917 is no longer a slogan. There is no power in the country above the councils. | | **Relentless Strategy**
`INT_pol_relentless_strategy` | 8 | Requires: Flexible Tactics | Tactics change; the goal does not. Every step, however small, is measured against the world revolution. | | **A Party Full of Factions**
`INT_pol_party_full_of_factions` | 8 | Requires: Concessions to the Soc-Dem | Tendencies, platforms and factions are allowed to organize openly inside the party. It is noisy, but nobody has to go underground to disagree. | | **Absolute Loyalty to the Revolution**
`INT_pol_absolute_loyalty` | 8 | Requires: A Complete Ideological Revolution | Loyalty is owed to the revolution, not to a leader or a faction. Those who confuse the two are reminded of the difference. | | **Support ComRev Around the World**
`INT_pol_support_comrev_world` | 8 | Requires: Alliance with Cuba | Money, weapons and volunteers for every revolutionary movement that asks. The revolution in one country is a contradiction in terms. | | **A True European Leninism**
`INT_pol_european_leninism` | 9 | Requires: Communism or Barbarism + All Power to the Councils! + Relentless Strategy | Italy was only the beginning. The councils, the party and the theory are ready to be carried across the whole continent. | | **Trotskyism Is Young Once Again**
`INT_pol_trotskyism_young_again` | 9 | Requires: A Party Full of Factions + Absolute Loyalty to the Revolution + Support ComRev Around the World | The old man in Coyoacán was murdered, his followers were scattered and for eighty years the movement survived in back rooms. Now it has a country. |

sections.title: Post-war focus tree — Foreign policy (29 focuses)
sections.body:
| Focus | Tier | Requirements | Description | |---|---|---|---| | **Revolution Crosses the Alps**
`INT_for_revolution_crosses_alps` | 1 | — | Italy was the first link to break. The question is no longer whether the revolution leaves the peninsula, but how. | | **Long Live the Councils' International**
`INT_for_councils_international` | 2 | Requires: Revolution Crosses the Alps
Excludes: Revolutionary International | An international of workers' councils, not of parties or governments. Its sections will be built wherever the working class rises. | | **Revolutionary International**
`INT_for_revolutionary_international` | 2 | Requires: Revolution Crosses the Alps
Excludes: Long Live the Councils' International | The Fourth International is reborn, this time with a state, an army and a treasury behind it. | | **Leninist France**
`INT_for_leninist_france` | 3 | Requires: Long Live the Councils' International | The Communards have held Paris before. This time they will not be left to fight alone. | | **Yugoslav Revolution**
`INT_for_yugoslav_revolution` | 3 | Requires: Long Live the Councils' International | Trieste is a border town again, and on the other side the partisans' grandchildren have rebuilt the federation. | | **Principle of Permanent Revolution**
`INT_for_permanent_revolution_principle` | 3 | Requires: Revolutionary International | A revolution that stops at its own borders dies there. The Internationale commits itself to carrying it further. | | **Leninist Spain**
`INT_for_leninist_spain` | 4 | Requires: Leninist France | Madrid and Lisbon rose within weeks of each other. The Internationale offers both republics its protection. | | **Scandinavian Revolution**
`INT_for_scandinavian_revolution` | 4 | Requires: Yugoslav Revolution | The model welfare states of the North ran out of welfare before they ran out of workers. | | **Exporting the Revolution**
`INT_for_exporting_revolution` | 4 | Requires: Principle of Permanent Revolution | Paris, Madrid, Lisbon. The revolutions of the West get what they need from Milan, and Milan gets their loyalty. | | **Leninist Germany**
`INT_for_leninist_germany` | 5 | Requires: Leninist Spain | Without Germany, Lenin said, the revolution in the West could not hold. The German comrades are brought into the fold. | | **The World Is Burning**
`INT_for_world_is_burning` | 5 | Requires: Scandinavian Revolution | Athens, once more. The austerity years left a generation with nothing to lose, and they have taken the Acropolis. | | **They Are All Sister Republics**
`INT_for_sister_republics` | 5 | Requires: Exporting the Revolution | There are no foreign revolutions, only sections of the same one. Berlin and London are brought under a single command. | | **Leninist Britain**
`INT_for_leninist_brittany` | 6 | Requires: Leninist Germany | The oldest industrial working class in the world has finally settled its account with the City of London. | | **Domino Effect**
`INT_for_domino_effect` | 6 | Requires: The World Is Burning | One revolution makes the next one easier. Warsaw is the proof. | | **Cascade Effect**
`INT_for_cascade_effect` | 6 | Requires: They Are All Sister Republics | Every revolution that holds makes the next one inevitable. The Balkans and the North fall in line. | | **Internationalist Europe**
`INT_for_internationalist_europe` | 7 | Requires: Leninist Britain + Domino Effect | From the Channel to the Aegean, the councils of Europe answer to one International. The East is next. | | **Revolutionary Europe**
`INT_for_revolutionary_europe` | 7 | Requires: Cascade Effect | From Lisbon to Warsaw, one continent and one revolution. The last capitals of the old order are in the East. | | **Create a Leninist Network in Ukraine**
`INT_for_leninist_network_ukraine` | 8 | Requires: Internationalist Europe | Years of war have left Ukraine's industrial cities full of veterans with no love for Kyiv or Moscow. Cells are organized in the factories of the east. | | **Support the Russian Leninists**
`INT_for_support_russian_leninists` | 8 | Requires: Internationalist Europe | The Russian comrades are few, hunted and badly armed. The first two problems cannot be fixed from Milan; the third can. | | **Revolutionary Communists of Russia**
`INT_for_revcom_russia` | 8 | Requires: Revolutionary Europe | Trotsky's heirs in Russia never stopped organizing. Now they have a sponsor. | | **Support a Red Ukrainian Resistance**
`INT_for_red_ukrainian_resistance` | 9 | Requires: Create a Leninist Network in Ukraine | The network stops talking and starts organizing strikes, occupations and, where needed, something more. | | **Support the Leninists in Belarus**
`INT_for_leninists_belarus` | 9 | Requires: Support the Russian Leninists | Minsk still has its tractor plants and its disciplined workforce, and its workers have not forgotten how to strike. | | **Revolutionary Communists of Ukraine**
`INT_for_revcom_ukraine` | 9 | Requires: Revolutionary Communists of Russia | Kharkiv and Dnipro were once red strongholds. The revolutionary communists of Ukraine are given the means to make them so again. | | **Support the Baltic Resistance**
`INT_for_baltic_resistance` | 10 | Requires: Support a Red Ukrainian Resistance | Tallinn, Riga and Vilnius have their own workers' movements, small but stubborn. The Internationale sends money, printers and organizers. | | **Prepare the Soviets for a Revolution**
`INT_for_prepare_soviets_revolution` | 10 | Requires: Support the Leninists in Belarus | Soviets are forming again in Petersburg and the Urals, in secret for now. When the moment comes, they will know what to do. | | **Bring the Revolution Back to Russia**
`INT_for_bring_revolution_russia` | 10 | Requires: Revolutionary Communists of Ukraine | The revolution was born in Petrograd and died in Moscow. It is time to take it home. | | **Bring Leninism Back to Russia**
`INT_for_bring_leninism_russia` | 11 | Requires: Support the Baltic Resistance + Prepare the Soviets for a Revolution | Ukraine, Belarus and the Baltic are ready, and the soviets are waiting. Lenin's country will have Leninism again, whether its rulers like it or not. | | **Exporting the Revolution to the US**
`INT_for_revolution_to_us` | 11 | Requires: Bring the Revolution Back to Russia | The permanent revolution does not stop at the Atlantic. The American comrades get money, organizers and the full backing of the International. | | **Accelerate the Collapse of the United States**
`INT_for_collapse_united_states` | 12 | Requires: Bring Leninism Back to Russia | The empire is rotting from within: debt, division and a working class that has stopped believing in it. The Internationale only has to help it along. |

sections.title: Post-war focus tree — Military (44 focuses)
sections.body:
| Focus | Tier | Requirements | Description | |---|---|---|---| | **Military Decision Center**
`INT_mil_military_decision_center` | 1 | — | The militias won the civil war. Turning them into an army that can hold a border is a different job. | | **The Red Army**
`INT_mil_red_army` | 2 | Requires: Military Decision Center | The brigades, the Red Guards and the internationalist volunteers are merged into a single Red Army of the Internationale. | | **Proletarian Military Industries**
`INT_mil_proletarian_military_industries` | 2 | Requires: Military Decision Center | Beretta, Leonardo, Fincantieri and Iveco now belong to the people who work in them, and the people have a war to prepare for. | | **Military Commissars**
`INT_mil_military_commissars` | 3 | Requires: The Red Army | Many of the new army's officers served the old state. Every one of them gets a commissar at their side. | | **Reforming the Military Corps**
`INT_mil_reforming_military_corps` | 3 | Requires: The Red Army | The corps structure of the old army is torn up and rebuilt around what actually worked in the civil war. | | **Smart Military Manufacturing**
`INT_mil_smart_military_manufacturing` | 3 | Requires: The Red Army | Lines that switch from rifles to drones in a week, designed by the engineers who will use them. | | **National Academies of Sciences**
`INT_mil_national_academies_sciences` | 3 | Requires: Proletarian Military Industries | The universities of Milan, Turin and Bologna are organized into academies that work directly for the plan. | | **Total Industrial Mobilization**
`INT_mil_total_industrial_mobilization` | 3 | Requires: Proletarian Military Industries | Every plant that can make something useful for the army will make it, starting this month. | | **Ultra-Engineered Equipment**
`INT_mil_ultra_engineered_equipment` | 3 | Requires: Proletarian Military Industries | Italian design was always good at making beautiful machines. The revolution wants them to be unbreakable as well. | | **Political Commissars**
`INT_mil_political_commissars` | 4 | Requires: Military Commissars + Reforming the Military Corps | The commissars stop checking up on the officers and start educating the soldiers. Every unit knows what it is fighting for. | | **Trial of the Corrupt and Traitors**
`INT_mil_trial_corrupt_traitors` | 4 | Requires: Reforming the Military Corps | Quartermasters who sold fuel to the enemy and colonels who kept their old friends informed face a people's tribunal. | | **Peer-to-Peer Production**
`INT_mil_peer_to_peer_production` | 4 | Requires: Smart Military Manufacturing + Reforming the Military Corps | Open designs shared between every arms plant in the country. A fix found in Brescia is running in Bologna by the next shift. | | **Reindustrialization**
`INT_mil_reindustrialization` | 4 | Requires: National Academies of Sciences + Total Industrial Mobilization | The industrial districts that globalization emptied are filled again, this time with plants that cannot be moved abroad. | | **Optimize Production Lines**
`INT_mil_optimize_production_lines` | 4 | Requires: Total Industrial Mobilization | Time-and-motion studies, done by the workers themselves this time. | | **A Tsunami of Military Hardware**
`INT_mil_tsunami_military_hardware` | 4 | Requires: Ultra-Engineered Equipment or Total Industrial Mobilization | The first mobilization quotas are met ahead of schedule. The depots are filling faster than the army can empty them. | | **Loyal to the Revolution**
`INT_mil_loyal_to_revolution` | 5 | Requires: Political Commissars + Trial of the Corrupt and Traitors + Peer-to-Peer Production | Purged, reorganized and politically reliable, the Red Army is ready to be more than a garrison. | | **Centralize Military Structures**
`INT_mil_centralize_military_structures` | 5 | Requires: Reindustrialization + Optimize Production Lines + A Tsunami of Military Hardware | Army, navy, air force and war industry answer to one defence council in Milan. | | **Make Way for the Young**
`INT_mil_make_way_young` | 6 | Requires: Loyal to the Revolution | The commanders who proved themselves in the civil war are promoted over the heads of the old staff officers. | | **The Workers' Army**
`INT_mil_workers_army` | 6 | Requires: Loyal to the Revolution | Every factory trains its own reserve company. The army and the working class become the same thing. | | **The Cult of the Blitzkrieg**
`INT_mil_cult_blitzkrieg` | 6 | Requires: Loyal to the Revolution | Speed, concentration and surprise. The next war will be decided in its first weeks. | | **Expand the Red Navy**
`INT_mil_expand_red_navy` | 6 | Requires: Centralize Military Structures | The yards of Monfalcone and Livorno are turned over to warships. | | **Expand the Aircraft Industry**
`INT_mil_expand_aircraft_industry` | 6 | Requires: Centralize Military Structures | The aerospace plants around Turin and Varese are given priority on materials and engineers. | | **Expand the Army**
`INT_mil_expand_army` | 6 | Requires: Centralize Military Structures | New divisions need new recruits, new barracks and new depots. | | **The Red Airforce**
`INT_mil_red_airforce` | 7 | Requires: Make Way for the Young + The Workers' Army | Pilots from the old air force and drone operators from the militias, under one command. | | **The Red Navy**
`INT_mil_red_navy` | 7 | Requires: The Workers' Army | The crews at La Spezia and Taranto have to be won over one ship at a time. The ones already on our side form the core of a new fleet. | | **A Mechanized Army**
`INT_mil_mechanized_army` | 7 | Requires: The Cult of the Blitzkrieg + The Workers' Army | Trucks, armoured carriers and the drivers to go with them. The infantry will not walk to the next war. | | **Submarine Warfare**
`INT_mil_submarine_warfare` | 7 | Requires: Expand the Red Navy | The Mediterranean is narrow and crowded. A fleet of submarines can close it to anyone we choose. | | **Increase Aircraft Production**
`INT_mil_increase_aircraft_production` | 7 | Requires: Expand the Aircraft Industry | Second and third shifts on every assembly line. | | **Start Motorizing**
`INT_mil_start_motorizing` | 7 | Requires: Expand the Army | Iveco's lines stop building delivery vans and start building troop carriers. | | **Study New Doctrines**
`INT_mil_study_new_doctrines` | 8 | Requires: The Red Airforce or A Mechanized Army | The staff college reads everything from Tukhachevsky to the drone war in Ukraine. | | **The Red Academies**
`INT_mil_red_academies` | 8 | Requires: The Red Navy or A Mechanized Army | Officer schools open to the sons and daughters of workers, teaching tactics alongside political economy. | | **Superiority of Tanks**
`INT_mil_superiority_of_tanks` | 8 | Requires: A Mechanized Army | Drones have not made the tank obsolete, only the badly used tank. | | **Offensive Maritime Strategy**
`INT_mil_offensive_maritime_strategy` | 8 | Requires: Submarine Warfare | The fleet will not wait in port to be sunk. It goes looking for the enemy. | | **Automatic Aircraft Systems**
`INT_mil_automatic_aircraft_systems` | 8 | Requires: Increase Aircraft Production | Drones that fly in swarms and aircraft that fly themselves. Pilots are too valuable to lose. | | **An Adaptable Red Army**
`INT_mil_adaptable_red_army` | 8 | Requires: Start Motorizing | No doctrine survives contact with the enemy. The army trains to change its plans faster than the enemy can change theirs. | | **Electronic Warfare**
`INT_mil_electronic_warfare` | 9 | Requires: Study New Doctrines + The Red Academies | Jammers, spoofers and signals intelligence. Modern battles are won in the spectrum first. | | **Quality Training Programs**
`INT_mil_quality_training` | 9 | Requires: The Red Academies | Fewer parades and more live-fire exercises. Every soldier trains as if the war started tomorrow. | | **Overwhelming Superiority**
`INT_mil_overwhelming_superiority` | 9 | Requires: Superiority of Tanks + The Red Academies | More tanks, more guns and more shells than the enemy can count, at the exact point where it matters. | | **An Oceangoing Navy**
`INT_mil_oceangoing_navy` | 9 | Requires: Offensive Maritime Strategy | The revolution has friends in Havana and Asmara. The navy must be able to reach them. | | **The Reds in the Sky**
`INT_mil_reds_in_the_sky` | 9 | Requires: Automatic Aircraft Systems | The red star over the Alps is painted on the wings of the Internationale's air force. | | **The Glory of the Red Army**
`INT_mil_glory_red_army` | 9 | Requires: An Adaptable Red Army | Songs, films and monuments. The army that won the civil war becomes the pride of the new republic. | | **The Revolution Above All!**
`INT_mil_revolution_above_all` | 10 | Requires: Electronic Warfare + Quality Training Programs + Overwhelming Superiority | Not the nation, not the party, not the leader: the revolution. | | **A Red Tsunami**
`INT_mil_red_tsunami` | 10 | Requires: An Oceangoing Navy + The Reds in the Sky + The Glory of the Red Army | The war industry is running at full capacity. When the Red Army moves, it will not run short of anything. | | **Workers of the World Unite**
`INT_mil_workers_of_world_unite` | 11 | Requires: A Red Tsunami + The Revolution Above All! | The Red Army of the Internationale is no longer an Italian army. It is the army of the working class, wherever it is. |

sections.title: Country Information
sections.body:
The Stalinist front (PdRC-PaP, later the unified PCI-U) ruling from Naples. It is the rival socialist current of the Internationale: the two fight each other as well as the fascists.

**TAG:** `SRI`  
**Name:** Socialist Republic of Italy (Italian)  
**Role in the civil war:** PdRC-PaP Front (Stalinist)  
**Starting ideology:** Authoritarian Socialist  
**Capital:** Naples (state Campania-Napoli, 117)  
**States at the outbreak:** 3  
**Divisions at the outbreak:** 16  
**Stability / war support / research slots:** 45% / 50% / 2

sections.title: Focus tree — Civil war (7 focuses)
sections.body:
| Focus | Tier | Requirements | Description | |---|---|---|---| | **United Communist Front**
`SRI_cw_united_communist_front` | 1 | — | The PdRC, the new PCI and Potere al Popolo have spent thirty years splitting over commas. With the Republic collapsing around them they finally agree on one thing: whoever holds Naples holds the South. | | **All Unite in a Party**
`SRI_cw_all_unite_in_a_party` | 2 | Requires: United Communist Front | A front is a committee that argues; a party is an apparatus that obeys. The organizations of the front dissolve into the Partito Comunista Italiano Unificato: one card and one line for everybody. | | **Buy Weapons from China**
`SRI_cw_buy_weapons_from_china` | 3 | Requires: All Unite in a Party | Beijing will not recognize us yet, but its export companies are less fussy. Containers marked as agricultural machinery are unloaded at night in the port of Naples. | | **Against the Trotskyists and the Black Barons**
`SRI_cw_against_trotskyists_and_black_barons` | 3 | Requires: All Unite in a Party | To the north the Internationale preaches world revolution; in Latina the fascists dream of their Social Republic. The Party has two enemies and one answer for both. | | **Request Chinese Forces**
`SRI_cw_request_chinese_forces` | 4 | Requires: Buy Weapons from China | Advisers first, then 'volunteers' with suspiciously uniform haircuts. The People's Republic does not send armies abroad; it merely fails to stop those who wish to go. | | **The Red Militia**
`SRI_cw_red_militia` | 4 | Requires: Against the Trotskyists and the Black Barons | Dockers from Naples, steelworkers from Taranto, students from half the South. They get a rifle, a red armband and a political officer, in that order. | | **Victory Over the Social-Fascists**
`SRI_cw_victory_over_social_fascists` | 5 | Requires: Request Chinese Forces + The Red Militia | Rome is ours. The bourgeois Republic, its Trotskyist would-be heirs and the blackshirts all went under the same heading in the Party press, and they have all ended the same way. |

sections.title: Focus tree — Politics (29 focuses)
sections.body:
| Focus | Tier | Requirements | Description | |---|---|---|---| | **PCI-U Congress**
`SRI_pol_pci_u_congress` | 6 | Requires: Victory Over the Social-Fascists | The first congress of the unified party meets in a capital that still smells of smoke. The war kept the factions quiet; peace gives them something to fight over. | | **Reformist Faction Majority**
`SRI_pol_reformist_faction_majority` | 7 | Requires: PCI-U Congress
Excludes: HardLine Factions Majority | The delegates side with the General Secretaries: a socialism that works with what it finds, looks to Beijing rather than to 1937, and prefers a full shop to a full prison. | | **HardLine Factions Majority**
`SRI_pol_hardline_factions_majority` | 7 | Requires: PCI-U Congress
Excludes: Reformist Faction Majority | The delegates side with the Central Committee. No concessions, no experiments, no 'characteristics': the Party already knows what socialism looks like, and it looks like it did. | | **KGB Model**
`SRI_pol_kgb_model` | 8 | Requires: Reformist Faction Majority | A security service that reads, files and waits. It is quieter than its predecessors and better educated, and it knocks on fewer doors because it already knows who is behind them. | | **XXI Century Communism**
`SRI_pol_xxi_century_communism` | 8 | Requires: Reformist Faction Majority | Fibre optics in the Party schools and data centres next to the steelworks. The theory stays the same; only the tools are allowed to be new. | | **Restore the Authority of the Party**
`SRI_pol_ref_restore_authority` | 8 | Requires: Reformist Faction Majority | The war was won by commanders, militias and local committees who all learned to decide by themselves. They will now unlearn it. | | **Restore the Authority of the Party**
`SRI_pol_hard_restore_authority` | 8 | Requires: HardLine Factions Majority | The war was won by commanders, militias and local committees who all learned to decide by themselves. They will be reminded who decides. | | **Old-School Communism**
`SRI_pol_old_school_communism` | 8 | Requires: HardLine Factions Majority | Portraits back on the walls, the Short Course back on the syllabus. What worked from the Elbe to the Pacific needs no updating for the Tyrrhenian. | | **NKVD Model**
`SRI_pol_nkvd_model` | 8 | Requires: HardLine Factions Majority | A security service with its own troops, its own courts and its own quotas. It answers to the Central Committee alone, and the Central Committee prefers not to ask. | | **The Socialist Dream**
`SRI_pol_socialist_dream` | 9 | Requires: XXI Century Communism + Restore the Authority of the Party (SRI_pol_ref_restore_authority) | A flat, a job, a pension and a holiday on the Adriatic. The Party promises its citizens a modest prosperity and asks them, in return, not to ask for anything else. | | **People's Democratic Dictatorship Model**
`SRI_pol_peoples_democratic_dictatorship` | 9 | Requires: XXI Century Communism | Democracy for the people, dictatorship over their enemies; the Party decides who belongs to which. The formula is borrowed from Beijing, along with much else. | | **Ensure People's Support**
`SRI_pol_ensure_peoples_support` | 9 | Requires: Restore the Authority of the Party (SRI_pol_ref_restore_authority) | Committees in every neighbourhood listen to complaints about buses, hospitals and rents, and some of the complaints are even dealt with. | | **Cadre Bureaucratic Based Planning**
`SRI_pol_cadre_bureaucratic_planning` | 9 | Requires: Restore the Authority of the Party (SRI_pol_hard_restore_authority) | The plan is written by the apparatus and carried out by the apparatus. Factories receive figures, not explanations. | | **Socialist People's Republic Model**
`SRI_pol_socialist_peoples_republic_model` | 9 | Requires: Old-School Communism | One party, one front, one list. The constitution is copied from the people's democracies of the last century, with the dates changed. | | **Trotskyism Is a Degeneration of Socialism**
`SRI_pol_trotskyism_degeneration` | 9 | Requires: Old-School Communism | The Party's verdict on the Internationale is final: not a mistaken current of the movement, but its disease. One does not debate with an infection. | | **Repudiate Trotskyism**
`SRI_pol_repudiate_trotskyism` | 10 | Requires: The Socialist Dream | The Internationale is beaten on the field; now it must be beaten in the libraries. Permanent revolution is officially declared an adventure paid for by other people's workers. | | **Democracy Within the PCI-U**
`SRI_pol_democracy_within_pci_u` | 10 | Requires: People's Democratic Dictatorship Model | Sections may debate freely until the line is decided, and several candidates may stand for the same post, provided they are all good comrades. | | **New Party Cadres**
`SRI_pol_new_party_cadres` | 10 | Requires: Ensure People's Support | Engineers, economists and administrators under forty take the place of men whose only qualification was having been there in the first winter. | | **Politburo of Yes Men**
`SRI_pol_politburo_of_yes_men` | 10 | Requires: Cadre Bureaucratic Based Planning | Every vote is unanimous and every meeting ends early. Those who once raised objections have been reassigned to provinces with very poor connections. | | **State Commanded from Above**
`SRI_pol_state_commanded_from_above` | 10 | Requires: Socialist People's Republic Model | Regions, municipalities and ministries become transmission belts. An order leaves Rome in the morning and is law in Reggio Calabria by evening. | | **A Wave of Purges**
`SRI_pol_wave_of_purges` | 10 | Requires: Trotskyism Is a Degeneration of Socialism | The lists are long and the criteria flexible: former front allies, officers with opinions, anyone who met the wrong person in the wrong year. | | **Anti-Corruption Campaign**
`SRI_pol_anti_corruption_campaign` | 11 | Requires: Repudiate Trotskyism | Tigers and flies alike: from the regional secretary with a villa in Posillipo to the clerk who sells permits. The trials are public, and popular. | | **Long Live the General Secretaries**
`SRI_pol_long_live_general_secretaries` | 11 | Requires: Democracy Within the PCI-U | No single name, no single portrait. The collective leadership turns its own blandness into a doctrine, and the country finds it reassuring. | | **Bureaucracy Serves the People**
`SRI_pol_bureaucracy_serves_the_people` | 11 | Requires: New Party Cadres | Fewer stamps, fewer counters, deadlines that bind the office and not only the citizen. Even the Italian state can be made to work, apparently. | | **Bureaucracy at the Helm**
`SRI_pol_bureaucracy_at_the_helm` | 11 | Requires: Politburo of Yes Men | The administrators have outlasted the revolutionaries, as they always do. The state now runs on files, and the files are in order. | | **Long Live the Central Committee**
`SRI_pol_long_live_central_committee` | 11 | Requires: State Commanded from Above | The Committee is always right because it is the Committee. Its portrait is a group photograph; nobody in it is smiling. | | **Arrest All the Counter-Revolutionaries**
`SRI_pol_arrest_counter_revolutionaries` | 11 | Requires: A Wave of Purges | The prisons of the old Republic prove too small for the new one. Camps are opened in the Sila and on the islands. | | **New Socialism for a New Age**
`SRI_pol_new_socialism_new_age` | 12 | Requires: Anti-Corruption Campaign + Long Live the General Secretaries + Bureaucracy Serves the People | Neither the barracks of the last century nor the market of this one. Italy has built a socialism that functions, and that may be its most subversive achievement. | | **A Party With a State**
`SRI_pol_party_with_a_state` | 12 | Requires: Bureaucracy at the Helm + Long Live the Central Committee + Arrest All the Counter-Revolutionaries | There is no longer any point where the Party ends and Italy begins. Every office, every factory and every regiment has two chains of command, and only one of them matters. |

sections.title: Focus tree — Economy (42 focuses)
sections.body:
| Focus | Tier | Requirements | Description | |---|---|---|---| | **State Capitalism**
`SRI_eco_state_capitalism` | 1 | Excludes: Market Socialism | One owner, one employer, one bank: the state. Lenin called it a step forward, and the Central Committee sees no reason to take the second one. | | **Market Socialism**
`SRI_eco_market_socialism` | 1 | Excludes: State Capitalism | The commanding heights stay with the state; below them, let prices do the paperwork. The General Secretaries have read their Deng. | | **Renationalization of Industries**
`SRI_eco_renationalization` | 2 | Requires: State Capitalism | Steel, energy, telecoms, motorways: everything the Republic sold off in the nineties comes back, without compensation. | | **Establish Gosplan**
`SRI_eco_establish_gosplan` | 2 | Requires: State Capitalism | A State Planning Committee is set up in the old Treasury building. Its first act is to discover that nobody knows how many factories the country has. | | **The Cult of Industrialization**
`SRI_eco_cult_of_industrialization` | 2 | Requires: State Capitalism | Chimneys on the posters, blast furnaces in the newsreels. Tonnes of steel become the measure of everything, including people. | | **The Belt and Road Initiative**
`SRI_eco_belt_and_road` | 2 | Requires: Market Socialism | Rome signed the memorandum once before and then lost its nerve. This time the cranes in Taranto and Naples really are painted red. | | **NEP Restarts**
`SRI_eco_nep_restarts` | 2 | Requires: Market Socialism | Small firms may hire, sell and keep their profits. A hundred years after Lenin's retreat, the Party retreats in good order to the same line. | | **A Red Consumer Market**
`SRI_eco_red_consumer_market` | 2 | Requires: Market Socialism | State brands, state malls, state advertising. The citizen is still a comrade, but on Saturdays he is also a customer. | | **Economic Sovereignty**
`SRI_eco_economic_sovereignty` | 3 | Requires: Renationalization of Industries | No foreign shareholders, no foreign creditors, no foreign rules. What Italy needs, Italy will make; what it cannot make, it will do without. | | **Nationalize All Industries**
`SRI_eco_nationalize_all_industries` | 3 | Requires: Establish Gosplan or Renationalization of Industries + The Cult of Industrialization or Renationalization of Industries | After the giants come the workshops, the family firms and the cooperatives. The Italy of small business enters the plan, whether it fits or not. | | **Comprehensive Work Planning**
`SRI_eco_comprehensive_work_planning` | 3 | Requires: The Cult of Industrialization | Every worker has a norm, every norm a deadline, every deadline an inspector. | | **Chinese Investors and Specialists**
`SRI_eco_chinese_investors` | 3 | Requires: The Belt and Road Initiative | Joint ventures in the industrial zones of the South, each with a Chinese partner, a Chinese engineer and a Party secretary to keep an eye on both. | | **Let Some Get Rich First**
`SRI_eco_let_some_get_rich` | 3 | Requires: NEP Restarts or The Belt and Road Initiative + A Red Consumer Market or The Belt and Road Initiative | A few will get rich before the others. The Party asks only that they do it visibly, pay their taxes and stay out of politics. | | **Socialist Consumerism**
`SRI_eco_socialist_consumerism` | 3 | Requires: A Red Consumer Market | A car, a phone and a television within reach of every family. A people with instalments to pay does not go out into the squares. | | **Repeal the Liberal Reforms**
`SRI_eco_repeal_liberal_reforms` | 4 | Requires: Economic Sovereignty + Nationalize All Industries + Comprehensive Work Planning | Thirty years of privatizations, labour-market reforms and European directives are struck out in one session. | | **Economic Partnership with China**
`SRI_eco_economic_partnership_with_china` | 4 | Requires: Chinese Investors and Specialists + Let Some Get Rich First + Socialist Consumerism | Tariffs fall, credit lines open and the lira is quietly pegged to the yuan. Italy is the People's Republic's door to the Mediterranean. | | **Revitalize the Italian Periphery**
`SRI_eco_revitalize_periphery` | 5 | Requires: Repeal the Liberal Reforms | The Mezzogiorno was promised development by every government since unification. This one sends concrete, rails and deadlines. | | **Tackle the Demographic Collapse**
`SRI_eco_tackle_demographic_collapse` | 5 | Requires: Repeal the Liberal Reforms | A country of pensioners cannot fulfil a plan. Nurseries, housing priority and medals for mothers, and far fewer exit visas. | | **End Landlordism**
`SRI_eco_end_landlordism` | 5 | Requires: Repeal the Liberal Reforms | Rented flats pass to the municipality, empty ones to whoever needs them. The rent is now a line in the state budget. | | **Allow Private Ownership of Homes**
`SRI_eco_allow_private_homes` | 5 | Requires: Economic Partnership with China | Eight Italians in ten owned their homes before the revolution. The Party decides this is one fight not worth having. | | **The Red Stock Exchange**
`SRI_eco_red_stock_exchange` | 5 | Requires: Economic Partnership with China | Piazza Affari reopens with a hammer and sickle above the door. The state holds fifty-one per cent of everything listed on it. | | **Meritocratic System**
`SRI_eco_meritocratic_system` | 5 | Requires: Economic Partnership with China | Examinations, rankings and promotions by results. The Party card still helps, but it no longer suffices. | | **Food Self-Sufficiency**
`SRI_eco_food_self_sufficiency` | 6 | Requires: Revitalize the Italian Periphery | State farms on the Tavoliere and in the Agro Pontino. Italy will eat what it grows, and bread comes before exports. | | **Centralized Work Assignment**
`SRI_eco_centralized_work_assignment` | 6 | Requires: Tackle the Demographic Collapse | Graduates are sent where the plan needs them, not where their mothers live. For Italy, this is the real revolution. | | **Tolerate the Shopkeepers**
`SRI_eco_tolerate_the_shopkeepers` | 6 | Requires: End Landlordism | The barber, the baker and the bar on the corner are left alone. Even the Central Committee wants its coffee made properly. | | **Professional Chinese Specialists**
`SRI_eco_professional_chinese_specialists` | 6 | Requires: Allow Private Ownership of Homes or The Red Stock Exchange + Allow Private Ownership of Homes or Meritocratic System | They arrive with the machinery and stay to teach how it is used: high-speed rail, batteries, networks, ports. | | **State Co-Owned Enterprises**
`SRI_eco_state_co_owned_enterprises` | 6 | Requires: The Red Stock Exchange | Private capital is welcome in strategic firms as a minority partner. It brings money and takes orders. | | **Export of Processed Products**
`SRI_eco_export_of_processed_products` | 6 | Requires: Meritocratic System | Not raw steel but machines, not grain but brands. 'Made in Italy' still sells, whatever flag flies over the factory. | | **Quantity Over Quality**
`SRI_eco_quantity_over_quality` | 7 | Requires: Food Self-Sufficiency + Centralized Work Assignment + Tolerate the Shopkeepers | The plan counts units, so units are produced. Whether they work is a matter for the next plan. | | **Eliminate Unemployment**
`SRI_eco_eliminate_unemployment` | 7 | Requires: Food Self-Sufficiency + Centralized Work Assignment + Tolerate the Shopkeepers | Everyone has a job by decree; the jobs are found afterwards. Southern youth unemployment disappears from the statistics and, largely, from reality. | | **Solidify the Party Cadres**
`SRI_eco_solidify_party_cadres` | 7 | Requires: Food Self-Sufficiency + Centralized Work Assignment + Tolerate the Shopkeepers | Factory directors are Party men first and engineers second. Loyalty is the one resource the plan never runs short of. | | **Join the WTO**
`SRI_eco_join_the_wto` | 7 | Requires: Professional Chinese Specialists | The Socialist Republic claims the seat of the state it replaced. The negotiations are long, and the West discovers it would rather trade than sulk. | | **A Pragmatic Approach**
`SRI_eco_pragmatic_approach` | 7 | Requires: State Co-Owned Enterprises | Black cat or white cat: the plan sets the goals, the managers choose the means, and ideology is consulted afterwards. | | **Investing in the Heavy Economy**
`SRI_eco_investing_heavy_economy` | 7 | Requires: Export of Processed Products + State Co-Owned Enterprises | The profits of trade are ploughed back into steel, shipyards and machine tools. | | **Building Stalinkas**
`SRI_eco_building_stalinkas` | 8 | Requires: Quantity Over Quality + Eliminate Unemployment + Solidify the Party Cadres | Monumental apartment blocks rise along the avenues of Rome and Naples, with high ceilings, heavy cornices and a waiting list. | | **Skyrocketing Production Quotas**
`SRI_eco_skyrocketing_quotas` | 8 | Requires: Quantity Over Quality + Eliminate Unemployment + Solidify the Party Cadres | The targets are raised every quarter, because the previous ones were met, at least on paper. | | **Reward Heavy Industry**
`SRI_eco_reward_heavy_industry` | 8 | Requires: Quantity Over Quality + Eliminate Unemployment + Solidify the Party Cadres | Steelworkers and miners get the best wages, the best flats and the first holidays. Everyone else gets the poster. | | **A New Tech Sector**
`SRI_eco_new_tech_sector` | 8 | Requires: Join the WTO + A Pragmatic Approach + Investing in the Heavy Economy | Technology parks around Naples, Bari and Bologna, with tax holidays for anyone who can write code and keep quiet. | | **State Corporatism**
`SRI_eco_state_corporatism` | 8 | Requires: Join the WTO + A Pragmatic Approach + Investing in the Heavy Economy | State, managers and the single trade union sit at one table and settle wages, prices and investment among themselves. Italy has seen this before, under another colour. | | **Military Overproduction**
`SRI_eco_military_overproduction` | 8 | Requires: Join the WTO + A Pragmatic Approach + Investing in the Heavy Economy | The arms factories produce more than the army can use. The surplus finds buyers. | | **A Socialist Economy as God Teaches**
`SRI_eco_socialist_economy_as_god_teaches` | 9 | Requires: Building Stalinkas + Skyrocketing Production Quotas + Reward Heavy Industry | Come Dio comanda: everything owned, everything planned, everything counted. Italy has become the last proper command economy in Europe. | | **The New Factory of the World**
`SRI_eco_new_factory_of_the_world` | 9 | Requires: A New Tech Sector + State Corporatism + Military Overproduction | What Guangdong was to the last generation, the Mezzogiorno will be to the next: Europe's workshop, under a red flag. |

sections.title: Focus tree — Military (22 focuses)
sections.body:
| Focus | Tier | Requirements | Description | |---|---|---|---| | **Create the Soviet Army**
`SRI_mil_create_the_soviet_army` | 1 | — | The militias of the civil war are disbanded and reborn as a regular army on the Soviet pattern: conscripts, ranks and a great many tanks on parade. | | **Politicized Military**
`SRI_mil_politicized_military` | 2 | Requires: Create the Soviet Army | Every officer carries a Party card and every unit has its cell. The army does not merely defend the state; it belongs to the Party. | | **Purge the Traitors of the People**
`SRI_mil_purge_traitors_of_the_people` | 2 | Requires: Create the Soviet Army | Officers who served the Republic too well, or changed sides too late, are retired, tried or simply not seen again. | | **Political Commissars**
`SRI_mil_political_commissars` | 2 | Requires: Create the Soviet Army | Each commander is given a second signature. The commissar teaches the troops why they fight and tells the Party how. | | **Relentless Propaganda**
`SRI_mil_relentless_propaganda` | 3 | Requires: Politicized Military or Purge the Traitors of the People or Political Commissars | Radio, posters, serials and school books speak with one voice, and it never stops. | | **Red Terror**
`SRI_mil_red_terror` | 3 | Requires: Politicized Military + Purge the Traitors of the People + Political Commissars | The security organs are given a free hand in the rear. Fear is cheap, and for a while it works. | | **Connections with China**
`SRI_mil_connections_with_china` | 3 | Requires: Politicized Military or Purge the Traitors of the People or Political Commissars | Italian cadets in the academies of Nanjing, Chinese attaches at every manoeuvre. | | **Sino-Italian Agreement**
`SRI_mil_sino_italian_agreement` | 4 | Requires: Relentless Propaganda + Red Terror + Connections with China
Excludes: Italian-Chinese Alliance | Licences, technology and credit, but no treaty. Italy will arm itself with Chinese help and fight only its own wars. | | **Italian-Chinese Alliance**
`SRI_mil_italian_chinese_alliance` | 4 | Requires: Relentless Propaganda + Red Terror + Connections with China
Excludes: Sino-Italian Agreement | A mutual defence pact signed in the Great Hall of the People. Whoever threatens Italy now threatens Beijing, and the reverse is also true. | | **Total Industrial Mobilization**
`SRI_mil_total_industrial_mobilization` | 5 | Requires: Sino-Italian Agreement or Italian-Chinese Alliance | Tractor plants turn out armoured vehicles and shipyards work three shifts. | | **Centralize Military Structures**
`SRI_mil_centralize_military_structures` | 5 | Requires: Sino-Italian Agreement or Italian-Chinese Alliance | Army, navy, air force and security troops are placed under one General Staff, and the General Staff under the Party. | | **Import Chinese Equipment**
`SRI_mil_import_chinese_equipment` | 5 | Requires: Sino-Italian Agreement or Italian-Chinese Alliance | Whole trainloads of trucks, guns and missiles cross Eurasia. The manuals are translated on the way. | | **Revitalize the Navy**
`SRI_mil_revitalize_the_navy` | 6 | Requires: Total Industrial Mobilization | Taranto and La Spezia are put back to work. A peninsula cannot be defended from the beach. | | **No Step Back Policy**
`SRI_mil_no_step_back_policy` | 6 | Requires: Centralize Military Structures | Withdrawal without orders is treason. Blocking detachments stand behind the line to remind the forgetful. | | **Start Motorizing**
`SRI_mil_start_motorizing` | 6 | Requires: Import Chinese Equipment | The infantry gets off its feet. Chinese designs are built under licence in Italian plants. | | **Revitalize the Air Force**
`SRI_mil_revitalize_the_air_force` | 7 | Requires: Revitalize the Navy | New squadrons, new airfields and pilots trained abroad. The red star is painted over the tricolour roundel. | | **Red Patriotism**
`SRI_mil_red_patriotism` | 7 | Requires: No Step Back Policy + Start Motorizing | Garibaldi and Gramsci share the same poster. The fatherland is socialist, but it is still the fatherland. | | **Mass Conscription**
`SRI_mil_mass_conscription` | 7 | Requires: No Step Back Policy + Start Motorizing | Two years of service for every citizen, and reserve duty until fifty. | | **Joint Military Forces**
`SRI_mil_joint_military_forces` | 8 | Requires: Revitalize the Air Force + Red Patriotism + Mass Conscription | Large combined exercises teach land, sea and air to fight the same battle. | | **The Motherland Above All!**
`SRI_mil_motherland_above_all` | 8 | Requires: Revitalize the Air Force + Red Patriotism + Mass Conscription | Everything for the front, everything for victory. There is no private life in a besieged country. | | **A Red Tsunami**
`SRI_mil_red_tsunami` | 8 | Requires: Revitalize the Air Force + Red Patriotism + Mass Conscription | Division after division, wave after wave. The General Staff counts on arithmetic. | | **URA! URAA!! URAAA!!!**
`SRI_mil_ura_uraa_uraaa` | 9 | Requires: Joint Military Forces + The Motherland Above All! + A Red Tsunami | The parade takes six hours to pass the Altare della Patria. Europe has not seen an army like this since 1945, and has not forgotten the last one. |
